description: Establish a green baseline for Public/frontend-v6 before making changes. Confirm the existing build/check/test all pass so any later failure is attributable to this task's edits.
steps: Prepend the nvm Node to PATH: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (verify with node -v -> v22.23.2).
From Public/frontend-v6 run: npm ci (node_modules is present but run to guarantee a clean install).
Run npm run check and confirm svelte-check reports 0 errors / 0 warnings.
Run npm test and confirm all vitest suites pass (note the count of passing tests, especially seo.test.ts and pwaManifest.test.ts).

Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds. Record the total client JS size: BYTES=$(find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -type f -printf '%s\n' | awk '{t+=$1} END {print t+0}'); echo $BYTES. Confirm it is <= 700000 (the CI budget).
Save a copy of the built manifest for later comparison: cp build/manifest.webmanifest /tmp/manifest.baseline.webmanifest (this is the reference to prove FEAT-002 does not change the manifest).
acceptance_criteria: npm run check exits 0 with 0 errors and 0 warnings
npm test exits 0 with all suites passing
npm run build exits 0 and total client JS bytes <= 700000
verification: cd Public/frontend-v6 && export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
findings: Green baseline established on branch fix/v6-pwa-lighthouse-scores; no source edits made. Environment: node -v = v22.23.2 (nvm PATH prepended). npm ci succeeded (4 low-severity audit advisories, not blocking). npm run check (svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --fail-on-warnings): exit 0, 0 errors / 0 warnings (one benign Vite configLoader:'native' warning about ./src/lib/ratings extension-less import printed to stderr but not a svelte-check warning). npm test (vitest): exit 0, 16 test files passed, 286 tests passed, 0 failed. Notable suites: src/lib/seo.test.ts and src/lib/pwaManifest.test.ts (3 tests) both pass; src/lib/tooling/firstLoadBytes.test.ts (10 tests) and src/lib/skins/critical-path.test.ts (29 tests) pass — the ::error:: lines in output are intentional negative-case fixtures inside firstLoadBytes.test.ts, not real failures. npm run build: exit 0. Total client JS = 621798 bytes (find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -type f), well under the 700000 CI budget (headroom ~78202 bytes). Saved build/manifest.webmanifest (2380 bytes) to /tmp/manifest.baseline.webmanifest as the reference for FEAT-002 no-change verification. BASELINE NUMBERS FOR LATER FEATURES: JS budget bytes=621798 (limit 700000); test count=286 across 16 files; manifest size=2380 bytes; manifest sha256=46731fcf3c1c3506d6a9919ec32592211f1d11adcf22fb750385bdf7063d34da. NOTE ON MANIFEST BASELINE: each execute_bash invocation gets an ephemeral /tmp that does NOT persist across tool calls/delegations, so a durable copy was ALSO saved to .agents/tasks/task-v6-pwa-lighthouse-fixes/manifest.baseline.webmanifest (byte-identical, 2380 bytes). FEAT-002 should compare the freshly built build/manifest.webmanifest against that durable copy (or its sha256 above), not against /tmp.
